gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads crisp and modern, its curves stopping well short of closing. Bruno Ace SC spreads its wide, expressive letters out like beads on a thread, so a larger size for it lets that stretch show.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with breathing counters. Bruno Ace SC earns its place big and brief, where its beaded, spread-out letters get room to be distinctive.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary plain sans with generous gaps in its curves. Cherry Swash goes for drama, with a horseshoe-wide c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, while Amulya simply keeps the text open and approachable.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-chillax: Loud meets loose here. Cherry Swash flings its c open like a horseshoe, and Chillax relaxes beneath it, its spaghetti-like lines leaving curves unfinished so the heavy heading never feels crowded.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each of its round letters. Cherry Swash above it hits harder, its horizontals matching the verticals in thickness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-spline-sans: Approachable, first of all, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Spline Sans gives a longer stretch of text a friendly, unhurried flow, while Cherry Swash above it keeps its commanding, horseshoe-open c.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-synonym: Dependable describes the text side, a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve. Synonym is the quiet half, and its steadiness is the pair's best quality against Cherry Swash's commanding swagger.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves finishing well before they close like bent cable. Cherry Swash is best at commanding attention with heavy diagonals, whereas Outfit is best at staying smooth, uniform and easy on the plain sans text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-plus-jakarta-sans: Precise, with a hint of swagger up top. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps a longer passage moving smoothly, its monoline sans-serif strokes holding curve endings apart while Cherry Swash handles the commanding opening.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads neutral and geometric, each glyph a ribbon of constant width. Over a longer passage, Space Grotesk keeps its counters breathing, a steady sans-serif counterweight to Cherry Swash's horseshoe-wide, commanding headings.
